title: Mosaic Woman Portrait
description: A woman with a green and blue mosaic face has her mouth open as if shouting. Her hair flows out in colorful swirls filled with white horses, flowers, and vines while a dog in a ruff collar stands on a ledge to the right and looks at floating orbs that contain faces.
